faqHeading.intro: 了解表面液位、井室维护、参考目标测距及配置选型所需的信息。

faqs.question: 无线雷达测距传感器测量什么？
paragraphs: 雷达测距传感器通过反射回来的无线电信号，测量从测量基准到目标表面的距离。宏太 H 系列将读数传送至远程监测平台。
确定测量基准与安装方式后，距离数据可用于换算水位、储罐液位和散装物料料位，也可用于观察选定目标的位置变化。

faqs.question: 如何选择量程和测量性能？
paragraphs: 根据目标最近与最远的位置确定所需量程。当前参考配置的测量范围为 0.3–12 m，精度参考为 25°C 宏太实验室条件下的 ±1 mm，读数分辨率为 1 mm。
请提供目标材质、安装位置及测量方向，便于宏太结合实际测量条件选择合适配置。其他量程需求也可纳入项目评估。

faqs.question: 距离读数如何换算成液位、料位或库存量？
paragraphs: 传感器固定在表面上方并沿竖直方向测量时，以设定的参考高度减去测得的表面距离，即可换算液位或料位。体积换算还需要容器几何尺寸或经标定的罐容表。
对于散装固体，还应考虑安装位置和物料表面形态。将测点处的局部料位与约定的容器、物料信息结合，可为库存规划提供参考。

faqs.question: 雷达测距可以用于液体和散装固体吗？
paragraphs: 雷达可用于观察液体表面，以及粮食、颗粒料、砂石等散装物料的表面。配置选择取决于介质、表面状态、容器形状和可用安装位置。
请提供介质、进料或注液方式，以及预期环境条件，便于宏太为储罐、料仓、料斗或开放水域测点评估合适方案。

faqs.question: 井内水位数据如何帮助检查淤积和堵塞？
paragraphs: 固定在污水井或排水井上方的雷达观察水面。将水位趋势与降雨、抽排及下游情况对照，可帮助维护团队选择需要检查的位置。
当井内干燥或排空后沉积物表面露出时，在确认回波有效的基础上，可参照已知井内基准评估该测点的沉积高度。选型时请明确需要观察的是水位、露出的沉积物高度，还是水下污泥界面。
水下污泥界面属于需要选用适当仪表的独立测量任务；判断管道堵塞的程度和位置，还需结合排水现场调查，水面距离本身不直接给出这些结果。

faqs.question: 测距变化如何用于结构位移监测？
paragraphs: 从独立、稳定的参考位置观察明确的目标，将当前距离与初始基准距离比较，可得到沿测量轴方向的相对变化。需要解释为沉降时，应建立竖直测量布置或经验证的测量几何关系，并定期复核参考基准。
请提出需要分辨的变化量和监测周期，与项目工程师共同评估目标尺寸、对准情况、环境影响及现场重复性。这类项目按具体测量任务选型与验证；公开的实验室测距精度是配置参考，现场沉降观测性能还需结合基准、安装几何及环境条件验证。
对于接缝或支座间隙，安装构件与对侧目标之间的读数反映两者的相对开合。如果项目还需要绝对位移，应配合独立测量基准及相应测绘资料。

faqs.question: 雷达与超声波液位测量有什么区别？
paragraphs: 雷达使用电磁波，超声波测量使用声波。空气温度会改变超声波测量所依赖的声速，而雷达测距不依赖声速。两者对空气状态变化、粉尘、蒸气及被测表面条件的响应有所不同，均需要合适的测量路径与安装方式。
应结合介质、所需量程、可用安装空间及现场条件选择；如存在泡沫、凝露或附着物，请在应用评估时一并说明。

faqs.question: 非接触式雷达测距传感器应安装在哪里？
paragraphs: 选择刚性、稳定的安装点，使测量路径能够清晰到达预定表面或目标。用于液位或料位监测时，应结合容器形状、进料或注液位置及内部构件布置安装点，并确保完整运行过程中最近与最远的目标距离符合所选量程。
安装时建立测量基准，在投用调试阶段选择有代表性的液位或料位核对读数。

faqs.question: 无线连接、供电与上报如何配置？
paragraphs: H200 采用 LoRa，H300 采用 4G LTE，H500 采用 NB-IoT。根据安装点的网络覆盖与数据接收平台，选择通信配置，并分别明确采集、定时上报和通知要求。
H300 与 H500 通过约定的 MQTT 接入地址、认证方式和数据字段接入宏太云或兼容的客户平台。H200 使用兼容的 LoRa 接收器或网关，网关之后的平台连接按项目约定。
当前系列资料以每 4 小时定时上报为条件，提供超过 10 年的电池寿命参考。19,000 mAh 仅为 H300 的参考配置容量，其他配置按实际交付电池规格确认。实际寿命取决于所供电池、测量活动、数据发送、网络条件和环境温度。
采集设置确定何时测量，定时上报设置确定何时发送数据。平台接收与通知的时间，应结合约定的网络路径和平台工作流程验证。

faqs.question: 获取雷达测距传感器配置与报价需要提供哪些信息？
paragraphs: 请提供应用场景、目标材质、最近与最远的测量距离、安装位置和预计数量。现场照片或容器图纸有助于明确测量路径。
同时说明环境及工艺条件、所需测量与上报周期、无线网络覆盖、平台接入要求，以及希望监测的液位、料位或距离变化事件。

applications.title: 混凝土坝肩参考测点
applications.tagline: 以独立复核的参考，关联选定坝肩测点。
applications.summary: 以独立复核的参考，关联选定坝肩测点。

sources.use: Reflected radio signals, target size/material/orientation, separation of ranging from multidimensional/speed sensing. General engineering background, not Hitelecom component evidence.

sources.use: Radar uses electromagnetic waves; ultrasonic uses sound. Foam and installation matter. Do not transfer VEGA 80 GHz performance or frequency to Hitelecom.

sources.use: Beam path, perpendicular liquid-surface alignment, fill streams, obstructions and actual media testing. Exact ifm distances/angles/adapters are not Hitelecom requirements.

sources.use: Powders/pellets/granules, silos/bins/hoppers; industry breadth and surface geometry. Proves industry use, not Hitelecom installation history.

sources.use: Distinguishes point level, volume and mass; vessel geometry, density and sloping surfaces determine inventory interpretation.

sources.title: How do I find the best water level sensor for my monitoring site?
sources.use: Surface-water and flood/tide/drought use cases; site-specific selection. OTT radar figures do not apply to Hitelecom.

sources.publication_date: 2016 (manual filename; exact revision date not established)
sources.use: Stable reference mounting, clear water path, bridge movement and false reflections. Model-specific limits are not transferred.

sources.title: Testing and use of radar water level sensors by the U.S. Geological Survey
sources.use: Water level/stage supports discharge only with a station-specific relationship. Non-contact monitoring has a documented public engineering basis; no Hitelecom endorsement.

sources.title: Anti-Collision and Equipment Positioning
sources.use: Technical examples of distance and alignment monitoring; exclude safety/control claims from a battery periodic-reporting Hitelecom page.

sources.title: Hitelecom Radar Distance Sensor
sources.use: Current family page claims a wider customizable range and a one-hour battery profile. These differ from the specific model PDF; do not blend them into a universal H310-MW012 specification.

sources.title: Hitelecom H310-MW012 Datasheet
sources.use: Model reference: 300–12,000 mm range, ±1 mm accuracy at 25°C in Hitelecom Lab, 1 mm reading resolution, less than 20° beam, IP68, −30 to +75°C operation, 4G/NB-IoT/LoRa options. The table battery profile is two-hour reporting; it is not a field displacement acceptance test or proof of hazardous-area approval.

sources.title: Level measurement in the sewer network
sources.use: Primary industry example of overhead radar measuring wastewater/rainwater level in sewer networks. Humidity, condensation and foam are identified process challenges.

sources.title: Gully — level measurement
sources.use: Primary industry example of gully-level trends supporting deposit and blockage maintenance planning. This is evidence for the application class; it is not proof that H310-MW012 measures sediment beneath standing water.

sources.title: Turbimax CUS71D ultrasonic interface sensor
sources.use: Sedimentation-interface measurement is addressed by a submerged ultrasonic interface sensor. A free-space radar aimed at a water surface is a different measurement task.

sources.title: Silos for bulk solids — level measurement
sources.use: Primary bulk-solids radar application example covering silos, stockpiles and bunkers. Dust, abrasion, changing media, bulk density and explosion protection are selection factors. Competitor process ratings are not transferable to Hitelecom.

sources.title: RangeVue 15 radar water-level sensor
sources.use: Primary instrument description confirms the general method: distance to the water surface converted to water level/stage relative to a reference. Its 80 GHz, 8° beam and approvals belong to that product, not H310.

sources.title: Streamgaging Basics
sources.use: Water level and streamflow are different quantities. Discharge conversion requires a site-specific stage–discharge relationship based on field measurements.

sources.title: Smart Data Fusion Technology
sources.use: Structural radar line-of-sight displacement and three-dimensional movement are different outputs; combining surveying and radar can support 3D interpretation. This specialized mapping platform does not establish equivalent H310 capabilities.

sources.title: MyMo Structural Health Monitoring System
sources.use: An interferometric structural-health instrument is designed for static/dynamic behavior and multiple measurement points. A periodic single-point battery distance sensor must not inherit these capabilities by calling both products radar.

sources.title: USACE EM 1110-2-1009 Structural Deformation Surveying
sources.use: The official manual catalogue states that structural-deformation surveying has accuracy, procedure and quality-control requirements. The PDF itself could not be fetched in this tool session, so detailed clauses are not cited here.

sources.title: ATEX and explosive atmospheres
sources.use: Combustible dusts, gases and vapours can require hazardous-area classification and appropriate equipment selection. This general requirement does not prove that Hitelecom has ATEX/IECEx, mining or other Ex approval.

sources.title: Smarter Sludge Monitoring with IIoT Radars
sources.use: A competitor case describes radar above a sludge retention basin measuring the exposed process surface; it is not a claim of seeing a submerged sludge/water interface, and is not a Hitelecom customer case.

sources.title: Level and pressure instrumentation for wastewater treatment
sources.use: Primary wastewater application examples include water level upstream/downstream of screens, pump shafts and overflow basins. Paired readings can support site-specific head-loss assessment.
